metadata.title: Filecoin ProPGF Batch 3
metadata.description:
Filecoin ProPGF Batch 3 is a $2M milestone-based funding program designed to support critical ecosystem work that strengthens the Filecoin network and advances long-term ecosystem priorities. The standard scope of submitted projects should be within 3 to 6 month term. 

Batch 3 supports two primary categories of work:
- Core Infrastructure Maintenance: Funding for the maintenance and continued improvement of core infrastructure the Filecoin network depends on, including implementations, critical libraries, dependencies, indexing systems, retrieval infrastructure, and essential services that support network reliability and performance.
- RFP Responses: Funding for projects responding to specific Requests for Proposals (RFPs) published on [filpgf.io](https://filpgf.io/blog/propgf-batch-3-call-for-builders/) and [filecoin.io](https://www.filecoin.io/blog). These RFPs focus on support and innovation work aligned with operational and ecosystem priorities identified by Pods and ecosystem stakeholders.

Applicants are encouraged to review [The Filecoin Network Strategy](https://www.filecoin.io/blog/the-2026-filecoin-network-strategy) to help align proposals with broader ecosystem growth goals.

metadata.title: Filecoin ProPGF Batch 2
metadata.description:
Filecoin ProPGF Batch 2 is a $4M milestone-based funding program designed to accelerate innovation and strengthen the Filecoin ecosystem.

The program supports projects that make Filecoin more useful, resilient, and impactful — spanning infrastructure, research, governance, and user experience. It provides milestone-based grants to teams that directly contribute to the network’s growth, sustainability, and adoption.

The General Track funds a broad range of initiatives, including but not limited to:

1. Tooling & Developer Ecosystem – SDKs, APIs, infrastructure, and developer tools that improve the Filecoin developer experience.

2. Research – Technical, economic, or design research that advances the Filecoin protocol or ecosystem.

3. Customer Success – Initiatives that strengthen onboarding, documentation, and adoption across the ecosystem.

4. Governance – Mechanisms, tools, or frameworks that enhance transparency and collective decision-making.

5. End-User UX – Interfaces, integrations, and applications that make Filecoin more intuitive for everyday users.

Scroll DAO Community Council introduces the Community Grants Program. This is an effort to support communities worldwide with their community activations. The focus of these activations alongside Scroll should remain in allowing your audience to explore the Scroll ecosystem, its products, assets, or programs. 

**Evaluation Period:** On a rolling basis, 7 days after submission

**Who can apply for support?**
Community organizers from all over the world are welcome to apply. Whether you’ve been hosting local meetups, organizing a university club, running workshops for builders, or anything of a similar nature, we want to hear from you! 

**Are there any compliance requirements for applicants?**
For grants above $2,000, KYC/KYB verification will be required. All applicants will also be asked to sign standard AML statements through the application form.

**What can apply for support?**
Funds can be used to cover the cost of a space, snacks, beverages, and even swag in some cases. We encourage you to focus on items that are crucial to make your activation a success.

**How much funding is available per activation?**
The amount awarded will vary depending on size, scale of the activity, region, but there is a maximum cap of $10,000 USD. Preference towards applicants that propose a reasonable budget. We encourage smaller grassroots activations, rather than lavish gatherings.

**Can I apply for a virtual event?**
Yes, it can! We are accepting applications for in-person events, virtual, or hybrid.

**When is the deadline for the activity to take place?**
The activity must happen before January 31st, 2026.

**Do we need to provide any post-event deliverables?**
Yes, but nothing fancy. Any photos, videos, or social media posts that we can amplify would be great. Plus a brief recap on the Governance Forum to share your updates with the rest of our community.

**Can we collaborate with other local communities or sponsors?**
Yes! We encourage collaborations across different groups.

**When is the deadline for applications?**
Applications should be submitted by December 19th, 2025 at 11:59 UTC

**Any other questions?**
Reach out to community@scroll.io and we will be happy to answer any other questions you may have.

## About Kimia Protocol

Kimia is a Solana-native fixed-income protocol. It combines an on-chain perpetual futures exchange, a delta-neutral yield vault, and a tokenization layer that splits yield-bearing positions into **Principal (PT)** and **Yield (YT)** tokens, so traders can lock fixed rates, speculate on funding, or earn passively.Everything on Kimia is composable: the perp, the vault, the split, and the AMM are separate Anchor programs you can use in isolation.  
  
**What we’re building**

A single, composable stack on Solana that turns perpetual funding into transferable, tradable, lendable fixed income:

-   **On-chain perpetuals** with permissionless liquidation, Pyth Hermes pull oracles, and no privileged keepers, the yield source.
    
-   **A delta-neutral vault** that owns the hedge for you, the yield generator.
    
-   **PT + YT tokenization** so yield becomes two ERC20-style tokens you can sell, lend, or bundle, the yield distribution layer.
    
-   **A yield-space AMM** where PT and underlying trade at a price that decays into par at maturity, the fixed-rate discovery layer.
    
-   **An intent router** that guarantees the end-to-end APY you asked for, across three transactions, the UX layer.
    
-   **KUSD Stablecoin** introduces delayed settlement.
    

## **Your Mission**

Dive deep into Kimia Protocol and create an **engaging Twitter thread** with **6+ tweets** that showcases your understanding. The ideal submission will:

1.  **Introduce Kimia** and its background.
    
2.  Explain how **the problems we are solving and if it is noble.**
    
3.  Present an overview of **Kimia Protocol’s core features** and how it differs from it’s competitors.
    
4.  Discuss the **role of Solana** and how it can be the home of ‘The yield layer for perps’.
    
5.  Explain the **potential impact of Kimia** on the broader DeFi landscape.
    
6.  Roast us, give us your genuine feedbacks.
    

### **Bonus Points for:**

-   Writing in a way that is accessible to **crypto newcomers** and seasoned DeFi enthusiasts alike.

-   **Highlight what you want as a user.** Also tell us what can be the possible experimentation that you can do with it.

# The Flipcash Currency Creator

### The best of Bitcoin, Stablecoins, and Memecoins, combined into a magical payments experience

Flipcash is a new platform that lets anyone create a currency and immediately use it as money. You can send it, spend it, or tip it.

Every currency is created with 21 million coins. Those coins are deposited into a trustless on-chain Reserve that manages supply and liquidity. This fixed supply can never increase, just like Bitcoin, so as adoption of your currency grows, so does its value.

The Reserve sells coins on a fixed pricing curve, taking payment in USDF, and buys coins from users on the same curve, guaranteeing liquidity and a price per coin at all times.

This system allows a community to create and use a currency while sharing in the upside as the community grows. The ultimate win win.

You can learn more at [flipcash.com](http://flipcash.com)

# Season 2: Anchor Open Round [2026]

**STATUS: OPEN**

## Current Round

This round is open 25th February 2026 - 30th June 2026 [$220,000 USDm available]

## Timeline

- This round is open 25th February 2026 - 30th June 2026
- Inform outcome to applicants: Within 2-4 weeks of submission, offered on a rolling basis
- Close out / end of grants: 4 months after contract signatory

## Anchor Mission and Fund Allocation

In alignment with Season 2's focus on sustainable ecosystem growth, Prezenti plans to explicitly support applications that generate revenue for the chain, whether through transaction fees, sequencer revenue contribution, or other mechanisms. This extends beyond the existing intent framework to teams building durable, revenue-positive infrastructure.

### The Revenue Concentration Reality

Analysis of mature L2 ecosystems reveals a consistent pattern: a small number of high-throughput, revenue-generating applications drive the overwhelming majority of sustainable chain economics. On leading L2s, it's common for a single application category — whether DEXs, prediction markets, or payments infrastructure — to account for 40–60% of total ecosystem revenue. Networks that attract these anchor applications early compound their advantage through liquidity effects, user retention, and sustainable fee generation. The key differentiator is no longer technical. Arguably it has never been: it's distribution.

## Eligibility & Focus

**What we're looking for:**

- Verifiable evidence of real usage (transactions, users, revenue)
- Clear path to generating meaningful transaction volume on Celo
- Product-market fit demonstrated elsewhere, or credible pilot results within MiniPay
- Teams slightly below Stage 2 funding thresholds may be considered where a proven track record and substantial evidence demonstrate imminent viability

| Stage | Profile | Est. Daily TXs | Grant size |
|-------|---------|----------------|------------|
| Stage 1 | — | >5k daily tx's | — |
| Stage 2 | Valora apps, Mini apps | 10K – 100K | $25k est |
| Stage 3 | Seed-stage or scaled products with traction | 100k–500k | $50k est |
| Stage 4 | Mature ecosystem apps | 500k+ | Case-by-case |

- **Must** demonstrate 10k–100k daily transactions on Celo mainnet [if you cannot demonstrate these daily tx's then you should be able to demonstrate a good level of sustained transactions over a period of time]
- We are ideally looking for a sustained daily average over 5,000 tx
- Projects should be deployed, open to the public, and open source or published

## Not Eligible

- Ongoing salaries, pure marketing spend, events, liquidity provision, token listings, or general VC investment
- Applications gaming transaction counts without generating underlying value, e.g. spamming micro USDT transfers to addresses with little previous history
- Projects without verifiable traction or credible usage evidence
- Teams that cannot articulate how they contribute to transaction growth or TVL

## General Information

- One-off grant cUSD to all successful applicants
- Payments will be split 20% at project onset, and 80% after agreed delivery
- For unsuccessful applications there will be some feedback
- Applicants will be KYC'ed and sign a contract with Prezenti

## Evaluation Rubric

The Prezenti review team will use the rubric below to help guide and grade proposals. To arrive at a final decision, Prezenti will evaluate each proposal and come to a consensus through an internal vote.

| Criterion | Score | Notes |
|-----------|-------|-------|
| Alignment | 0: No clear alignment / 1: Partial alignment with no notable gaps | — |
| Open Source Commitment | 0: No / 1: Yes / Partial | Comment |
| Demo Quality | 0: No demo / 1: Yes / Explains concept | — |
| Team Assessment | 0: Can't assess / bad / 1: Strong team | — |
| Metrics / KPIs | 0: Not good / 1: Somewhat good / good | — |
| Correctly specified their appropriate stage? | 0: No / 1: Yes | — |
| Clear understanding of the actual demand for this product | 0: Not clear, no real understanding demonstrated / 1: Somewhat good / good | — |
| Do they have a clear financial plan for sustainable growth? | 0: No / 1: Yes / Partial | — |
| Discretionary factor | -1 / 0 / 1 | Comment |

## Grant Submission Outcomes Process

After you have submitted your application on Charmverse, you will need to wait for an outcome. This typically takes around 4 weeks from submission, although we strive to turnaround applications faster.

Although Charmverse has an outcome function, we will first inform you via email. This will be sent to the email address of the lead submitted within the Charmverse application. This is so we have a full audit trail of each application in our systems / in case Charmverse goes down.

Once the emails have been issued we will then update Charmverse with the outcomes to be public and close off the Charmverse process.

metadata.description:
## **About Superteam Ukraine**

Superteam Ukraine is focused on growing the Solana ecosystem in Ukraine. We connect the best Ukrainian talent with opportunities in the Solana and Web3 ecosystem, helping them find jobs, get grants, and launch their projects.

### **About the Bounty**

Superteam Ukraine is commissioning a student research piece exploring how modern neobanks ( led by Revolut ) have built crypto holding and transfer features directly inside a banking app, and what it would realistically take for Ukrainian neobanks to offer the same once the legal framework allows it.

This is not a critique of Ukrainian banks. It is a practical deep dive into the mechanics, economics, and strategy behind in-app crypto banking ( using Revolut as the clearest working example ) and a forward-looking analysis of how Ukrainian players could move quickly when the regulatory starting gun fires.

The piece should be accessible, well-sourced, and genuinely useful for students, fintech professionals, and anyone curious about where Ukrainian banking is heading.

### **🎓 Eligibility**

**This bounty is open exclusively to students of Kyiv National Economic University (KNEU) and** **Borys Hrinchenko Kyiv University**

### **Scope (What to Cover)**

**1\. How Revolut handles crypto — under the hood**

-   What mechanisms does Revolut use to store crypto on behalf of users? (Custodial model, omnibus wallets, third-party custodians)
    
-   How does crypto transfer between Revolut users work: is it on-chain or internal ledger movement?
    
-   How is this fundamentally different from a crypto exchange (like Binance) or a DeFi protocol?
    
-   What happens to a user's crypto if their Revolut account is frozen or blocked: how fast is access restored, are fees charged, can assets be withdrawn?
    
-   What limits do users face: purchase limits, withdrawal limits, supported assets, geographic restrictions?
    

**2\. The business case — is crypto profitable for a neobank?**

-   Revenue model: how does Revolut earn on crypto? (Spread fees, exchange markup, subscription upsell, staking revenue)
    
-   What are the additional costs of offering crypto: custody infrastructure, compliance overhead, licensing, insurance?
    
-   Has crypto been a net positive for Revolut's growth? Cite available data from Revolut's annual reports or public filings
    
-   How many users chose Revolut _because_ of crypto features, and how many started using crypto _because_ Revolut made it easy? (acquisition vs. activation angle)
    

**3\. GTM strategy — how Revolut onboarded crypto users**

-   What marketing and product strategies did Revolut use to introduce crypto to mainstream banking users?
    
-   Key campaigns, partnerships, referral mechanics, and in-app nudges that drove crypto adoption
    
-   How did Revolut position crypto: as investment, as spending tool, or as both?
    
-   Lessons other neobanks could apply from Revolut's crypto onboarding playbook
    

**4\. Legal landscape — why Ukrainian neobanks can't do this yet**

-   What specific legal limitations prevent Ukrainian banks from offering crypto holding today?
    
-   Key regulatory blockers: NBU position, LUVA (Law on Virtual Assets) implementation status, wartime capital controls
    
-   Side-by-side comparison: what licenses and regulatory approvals does Revolut hold (FCA, Lithuanian EMI, MiCA readiness) vs. what currently exists in Ukraine?
    
-   What would need to change in Ukrainian law, specifically for a neobank to legally offer the same features?
    

**5\. The readiness question — how fast could Ukrainian neobanks move?**

-   If Ukrainian crypto law were aligned with EU standards tomorrow, what would a neobank need to launch crypto features within 6–12 months?
    
-   Technical requirements: custody partner, wallet infrastructure, on/off-ramp integrations, compliance tooling
    
-   Operational requirements: staff, AML/KYC processes, customer support for crypto edge cases
    
-   What could slow them down even after the law changes: legacy core banking systems, talent gaps, risk appetite?
    
-   On the example of a Ukrainian neobank (Sense Bank, monobank, or similar): what is their current public attitude toward crypto? Have any representatives commented on readiness or future plans? _(Direct interviews with bank representatives will be considered a strong advantage in evaluation)_
    

### **Deliverables**

**Main article (1,800–2,500 words):**

-   Executive summary (120–180 words)
    
-   2–3 original charts or tables — suggested:
    
    1.  Revolut crypto feature breakdown vs. typical exchange vs. DeFi — what users can and can't do
        
    2.  Cost/revenue breakdown of crypto operations for a neobank (estimated model)
        
    3.  Ukrainian neobank readiness checklist: what exists today, what's missing
        
-   **"What This Means for Ukraine"** section with 5–7 clear, actionable takeaways for students, founders, and bank operators
    
-   10+ credible citations (Revolut annual reports, NBU documents, Ukrainian legislation, reputable fintech and crypto media)
    

**Twitter/X thread (8–12 tweets):**

-   Summarizes the key findings in plain language
    
-   Must tag **@SuperteamUKR**
    
-   Should be punchy and shareable: written for a general audience, not just specialists
    

### **KPIs**

-   **Depth:** Revolut mechanics explained clearly enough for a non-technical reader
    
-   **Rigor:** 10+ credible, verifiable sources; no unverified claims
    
-   **Ukraine relevance:** Concrete analysis of local banks and regulatory context, not just a Revolut profile
    
-   **Accessibility:** Written so a second-year economics student can follow it without a crypto background
    
-   **Visibility:** X thread published and tagging @SuperteamUKR
    

### **Evaluation Rubric (100 pts)**

**Criteria**

Depth of research & originality - 30%

Ukraine specificity & practical relevance - 25%

Quality of data, visuals & structure - 20%

Writing clarity & accessibility - 15%

Distribution & social engagement - 10%

### **Timeline**

3 weeks from bounty publication

### **Submission**

-   Link to Google Doc or Notion (comment access enabled), with all charts included or linked
    
-   Link to published X thread tagging @SuperteamUKR
    

### **Notes**

-   Original work only; cite every factual claim
    
-   Tone: clear, professional, and accessible, write for smart people who are not crypto experts
    
-   Interviews or quotes from representatives of Ukrainian neobanks or fintech companies will be weighted highly in scoring
    
-   AI-assisted research is permitted; AI-generated text submitted without editing or original thought is not

Your task is to read the articles and create the best piece of content around them.

-   a clean recap

-   your own angle / takeaway
    
-   a more viral CT-style spin
    
-   it can be a tweet, meme, infographic, thread, video, or even your own article.

We’re not looking for a stitched-together summary of 4 posts. We’re looking for a piece of content that actually lands.

-   what is broken in current prediction market structure
    
-   why liquidity and execution still suck for normal users

-   show clear understanding of the problem being discussed
    
-   connect back to one of the original article’s main point

Is the content easy to understand, memorable, and genuinely engaging?

-   explain the idea in plain language
    
-   use a strong hook or creative angle
    
-   make complex crypto/AI/coordination ideas feel accessible
    
-   feel original rather than generic or copy-pasted
    

### 3\. Shareability

Would someone outside crypto understand it — and want to send it to a friend?

**Strong submissions:**

-   create an “oh, I get it” moment
    
-   are concise, punchy, and emotionally resonant
    

# Rules

-   English only
    
-   Must be original

-   Don’t just rewrite the articles
    
-   If it’s obvious you didn’t actually engage with the material, it won’t count

## Mission

Write one sharp X article (thread or long-form post, video format is accepted as well) that explains Trepa and positions it inside the prediction markets landscape. Treat the piece as a public good, not a puff piece. The article a curious builder would bookmark and reference later.

## About Trepa

Trepa is a one-minute forecasting game on Solana. Players submit a price prediction each round and are paid based on how close they are, not whether they guessed up or down. 30 seconds to forecast, 30 seconds to resolve, then the next round starts. Entry is 1 USDC. Full mechanics at [https://docs.trepa.io](https://docs.trepa.io).

## Scope

Your content must cover all four:

-   Explain Trepa in your own words and why precision payouts create different incentives than binary yes/no markets
    
-   Map the prediction markets landscape with a 2x2 matrix of your own design (axis choice up to you)
    
-   Honestly assess strengths, weaknesses, and trade-offs of the precision-payout model
    
-   Treat the analysis as a contribution to the literature on prediction markets
    

## Submission requirements

-   Public X post (thread or long-form article or video), link submitted via Superteam Earn
    
-   Short paragraph in the submission explaining your angle
    
-   At least one original visual (2x2 matrix, comparison table, diagram, gif, or annotated screenshot).
    
-   Tag @trepa\_io so we can selectively repost threads/articles that we like
    

## Judging

Submissions are scored on two dimensions: quality and engagement.

**Quality (75%)** is scored by the Trepa team on a 100-point scale:

We're looking for depth of research, originality of framing, clarity of explanation, and whether the piece would hold up as standalone reference material on prediction markets. Pieces that surface real trade-offs, build a defensible 2x2, or contribute genuinely useful analysis to the category will score highest here.

**Engagement (25%)** is scored on a public formula. Using a like as the baseline of 1, the multipliers are:

-   Retweets: 20x
    
-   Replies: 13.5x
    
-   Bookmarks: 10x

Welcome to Devlynix Buildathon 1.0, an asynchronous, weekend-long mini-hackathon designed specifically to help you transition from watching tutorials to building practical, real-world projects.

This hackathon focuses on the "Idea-to-MVP Sprint" model. We aren't looking for perfect code; we are looking for strong problem-solving, clean design, and a solid technical approach.

# **⚠️ IMPORTANT: MANDATORY STEP**

All official announcements, squad formations, and shortlisting results will be shared EXCLUSIVELY on our WhatsApp handles. Joining both is mandatory for participation.

**Format:** 48-Hour Asynchronous Online Hackathon
**Team Size**: 1 to 4 Members per Squad
**Goal:** Build a Minimum Viable Product (MVP) addressing specific community tech challenges.

# 🛠️ The Challenge: Choose Your Problem Statement
Squads must select one of the following real-world challenges to solve. Your goal is to build a functional MVP with a clean User Interface.

> **1. The Developer Proof-of-Work Platform 🚀**
Many developers build great projects but lose them in scattered GitHub repositories. Build a centralized showcase directory where developers can host their deployed projects, tag their tech stack, and attach demo videos. Include filtering options (e.g., MERN, Web3, AI) for easy discovery.

>**2. The "Execution-First" Accountability Tracker 🔥**
Students often get stuck in "tutorial hell." Build a web dashboard that tracks a user's daily or weekly "build streak" based on actual project execution. The app should prompt users with "What did you code today?", visualize their consistency, and reward them with milestones.

>**3. The Skill-Based Teammate Matchmaker 🤝**
Finding the right teammates for hackathons or side projects is a major hurdle. Design a user-directory system where individuals can create profiles highlighting their specific skills (e.g., UI/UX, React, AI) and proficiency levels. Implement a search and filter mechanism to connect users.

> **4. The Crowdsourced Learning Vault 📚**
The internet is flooded with scattered resources. Build an organized, community-driven resource hub where users can submit and categorize high-quality links, tools, and guides. Include an upvote/downvote system so the best resources naturally rise to the top.

>**5. The Micro-Event & Submission Portal 🎯**

metadata.description:
## About Loofta Pay

Loofta Pay is building the payment layer for the open economy — non-custodial, private, and cross-chain. Whether you're a freelancer invoicing a client in another country, a creator monetizing your audience, or anyone who wants to move money without giving up control, Loofta is built for you. Backed by MagicBlock's privacy infrastructure and cross-chain routing, Loofta makes crypto payments feel as easy as a link and as powerful as DeFi.

## Mission

Loofta Pay is a non-custodial payment platform built for creators, freelancers, and anyone who wants to send and receive money on-chain — privately, instantly, and across any chain. Powered by **MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup**, Loofta lets you pay and get paid the way you actually want: without sacrificing privacy, flexibility, or your income.

We're on the **road to mainnet** and we're inviting the Solana community to help us spread the word. Try the app, experience it yourself, then create content that shows the world what crypto payments should feel like.

* * *

## Road to Mainnet — Try It Now

Before creating content, we ask every participant to **actually use the app**. Here's what you can do today:

-   **Claim your unique username** — Link your Twitter/X handle and reserve your Loofta identity before mainnet. Your username becomes your payment address.
    
-   **Send faucet USDC to a friend** — Even if they're not on Loofta yet. They receive a link and can claim it with just their email or X handle. No wallet required on their end.
    
-   **Create a payment link** — Set it up in under 60 seconds. Share it. Let anyone pay you in any token, on any chain, while you receive exactly what you configured.
    

**App:** [**pay.loofta.xyz**](http://pay.loofta.xyz) **Telegram:** [**t.me/looftapay**](http://t.me/looftapay)

* * *

## Scope Detail

This bounty is open-ended. You are encouraged to be creative and personal — share your real experience using the app. There are no strict length, dimension, or formatting requirements. You may submit multiple entries across different formats.

Formats include:

-   X threads
    
-   Short-form videos (TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Reels)
    
-   Long-form videos (YouTube, Loom)
    
-   Memes
    
-   Infographics or illustrated explainers
    
-   Animations
    

* * *

## What Your Content Should Cover

Your content must address **both Loofta Pay and MagicBlock**. Below is a guide to the key themes — you don't need to cover everything in one post, but the more depth the better.

**Loofta Pay — Built for Creators & Freelancers**

-   Send and receive money across 25+ blockchains and any token — without the payer needing to hold the same asset as you
    
-   Create a payment link in seconds and share it anywhere
    
-   Claim your username and own your on-chain identity
    
-   Send USDC to someone who doesn't have a wallet yet — they claim it with their email/ X handle
    
-   Your earnings stay in your embedded wallet (powered by Privy) — no extra app needed
    
-   **Coming soon:** earn on your idle balance + a debit card to spend your crypto income anywhere
    

**MagicBlock — Private Ephemeral Rollup (PER)**

-   MagicBlock PER is the privacy layer underneath Loofta Pay
    
-   Payments settle privately on Solana — transaction details stay between sender and receiver
    
-   No compromise on speed or decentralization — ephemeral rollups process privately, then settle on-chain
    
-   This is not a mixer — it's a purpose-built privacy primitive for compliant, real-world payments
    
-   Withdrawals are routed through AML-compliant address verification, so privacy and compliance coexist
    

**Privacy + Multi-chain Withdrawals**

-   Withdraw your balance privately to any of 25+ supported blockchains
    
-   Choose any token you want on the way out — not just USDC
    
-   Privacy doesn't mean locked in — you stay in control of where your money goes and in what form
    

* * *

## Submission Requirements

-   Content must be published and live on **X** (or another public platform for video)
    
-   The post must tag **@looftapay** and **@magicblock**
    
-   You must have **tried the app** before submitting — mention your experience in the content or submission notes
    
-   Follow **@looftapay** on X before submitting
    
-   Include a link to your live post in the submission form
    

If submitting multiple entries across formats, include your primary link in the "Link to your Submission" field and additional links in the "Anything Else" field.

* * *

## Judging Criteria

-   **Accuracy** — Does the content correctly explain Loofta Pay and MagicBlock PER?
    
-   **Clarity & Creativity** — Is it easy to understand and genuinely engaging?
    
-   **Authenticity** — Did you actually use the app? Does it show?
    
-   **Shareability** — Would someone who doesn't know crypto forward this to a friend?
    

* * *

## Reward Structure

**Total pool: 600 USDC**

Place Reward 1st 150 USDC 2nd 125 USDC 3rd 100 USDC 4th 75 USDC 5th 50 USDC

**Best Video Bonus: +100 USDC** — The single best video submission (any platform) receives an additional 100 USDC on top of their prize placement. This bonus is cumulative.

Loofta reserves the right not to award one or more prizes if submissions do not meet the expected standard for accuracy, quality, and originality.

* * *

## FAQ

**What is Loofta Pay?** Loofta Pay is a non-custodial crypto payment platform for creators and freelancers. You create a payment link, share it, and receive funds in the token and chain of your choice — regardless of what the sender is paying with. Cross-chain routing happens automatically. No wallet required for the person paying you to get started.

**What is MagicBlock's Private Ephemeral Rollup (PER)?** MagicBlock PER is a privacy technology built on Solana. When you pay through Loofta using the private payment option, the transaction is processed through an ephemeral rollup that keeps payment details confidential between sender and receiver. Settlement still happens on-chain — it's not a black box — but the transaction details are shielded. This is the infrastructure that makes private payments on Solana production-ready.

**Your income earns while it sits** When you receive payments on Loofta, your USDC doesn't just wait around. Soon you'll be able to activate earning on your balance directly from the app — powered by one of the safest passive income vaults in DeFi. No lockups, no custodial risk, no manual steps. Your earnings compound quietly in the background while you focus on your work. It's the simplest way to make your freelance income work as hard as you do.

**What are Loofta Points and how do I earn them?** Every time you receive a payment on Loofta, you earn points. Points accumulate across all payments and unlock rewards and discounts with Loofta's partner ecosystem — including fee reductions, early access to new features, and partner perks. The more you use Loofta as your primary payment layer, the more you earn back just by getting paid.

**How does private withdrawal work?** When you're ready to move your funds, open your balance from the app and select Withdraw. You can send to any of **25+ supported blockchains** in any token you want. Before the withdrawal goes through, your destination address is verified for AML compliance server-side. Privacy and compliance coexist on Loofta.

**Do I need a crypto wallet to receive a payment?** No. If someone sends you USDC via Loofta and you don't have a wallet, you receive a claim link you can open with your email. Loofta creates an embedded wallet for you in the background. No installs, no setup.

**What's the Road to Mainnet?** Loofta Pay is currently live with a working app, heading toward mainnet. Right now you can claim your unique username (linked to your Twitter/X), send USDC to friends, and create real payment links. The username you claim now is yours on mainnet. Earn and debit card features are also on the way — stay close.

**Can I submit content in a language other than English?** Yes. Non-English submissions are welcome. Accuracy and clarity in your language are what matter.

**Can I submit more than one entry?** Yes. You may submit multiple entries in different formats. Each is evaluated independently.

* * *

## Resources

-   App: [pay.loofta.xyz](http://pay.loofta.xyz)
    
-   Twitter: @looftapay
    
-   MagicBlock: [magicblock.gg](http://magicblock.gg) / @magicblock

metadata.description:
## The task

Make a marketing video for your own Dutch Solana project. Use [Solana.new](http://Solana.new)'s /marketing-video skill to do it. Post the video as a tweet from your project's X account. Submit the tweet link here.

That's it. One video. One tweet. One submission.

## Why we're running this

Dutch projects in the Solana ecosystem build great things and then go quiet about them. This bounty forces the muscle: ship a piece of marketing, put your name on it, put it in front of people. You get a video asset you can reuse forever, and the best projects walk away with USDG.

## How to do it

1.  Install and run [Solana.new](http://Solana.new)'s /marketing-video skill on your project. ([solana.new](http://solana.new))
    
2.  Generate a marketing video for your project. Iterate until it actually represents what you do.
    
3.  (optional) add non-copyright music
    
4.  Post the video as a tweet from your project's official X account. Tag @superteamnl in the tweet.
    
5.  Submit the tweet URL as your bounty entry.
    

**No Claude Code, Codex, or similar agentic dev setup?** Apply for the [Agentic Engineering grant on Superteam Earn](https://superteam.fun/earn/grants/agentic-engineering) first, it covers the tooling. Then come back and submit.

## Submission requirements

-   Tweet must be from the project's own X account (not a personal account).
    
-   Tweet must include the video (native upload, not a link).
    
-   Tweet must tag @superteamNL
    
-   Project must be Netherlands-based (at least one founder based in NL).
    
-   Founder must be registered for Colosseum with NETHERLANDS as country
    
-   Submission = the tweet URL. Don't send us the raw video.
    
-   One submission per project.
    

## How we judge

Superteam NL judges. Two axes, roughly equal weight:

**Traction (the tweet performed)**

-   Views, likes, reposts, replies, bookmarks
    
-   Quality of engagement, not just volume
    

**Craft (the video is good)**

-   Hook in the first 3 seconds
    
-   Clarity: a stranger understands what you do
    
-   Production quality (doesn't need to be cinema, does need to be watchable)
    
-   Fit: feels like your brand, not a template
    

We'll weigh both. A slick video with zero traction loses to a rougher video that landed. A viral tweet with an incomprehensible video loses to a clear one with fewer views.

## Eligibility

-   Your project must be Dutch (at least one founder based in NL).
    
-   Your project must be building on Solana.
    
-   Your Dutch founder must be registered for Colosseum
    
-   You must submit the tweet from the project's official X account.

## **Build real-world finance with AUDD on Solana**

We’re looking for Solana builders to create practical, production-ready applications powered by [**AUDD**](https://www.audd.digital/) stablecoin, Australia’s digital dollar infrastructure.

AUDD is building the foundation for a fully backed, compliant Australian dollar stablecoin designed for real-world digital finance. From payments and settlement to treasury and programmable money, our goal is to make AUDD the default AUD asset for on-chain use cases in Australia. While this is a grant for the Australian Digital Dollar, **anyone in the world can apply**.   

If you’re a Solana developer with a strong product instinct and want to build something useful, this grant is for you.

### **What you’ll build**

We want teams or solo builders to develop a live Solana-based application, integration, or service that uses AUDD in a meaningful way.

This could include use cases such as:

-   payments
-   on-chain settlement
-   treasury management
-   programmable finance
-   merchant tools
-   consumer or business-facing financial apps

The key is simple: build something people can actually use.

### **What we’re looking for**

Your project should:

-   use AUDD as the on-chain Australian dollar stablecoin
-   solve a real problem or unlock a clear user benefit
-   be technically sound and feasible on Solana
-   deliver a smooth, intuitive user experience
-   be capable of shipping in a production-ready form

### **Who should apply**

You’re a strong fit if you have:

-   experience building on Solana
-   a solid understanding of stablecoins and on-chain finance
-   the ability to ship polished, reliable products
-   familiarity with payments, settlement, treasury, or financial primitives
-   a portfolio of previous Solana work

### **How to apply**

Send us:

-   a short proposal outlining your AUDD use case
-   how you plan to build it on Solana
-   links to relevant past work or portfolio
-   a few lines on why you’re the right builder for this
-   your quote in AUDD

### **Evaluation criteria**

We’ll assess applications based on:

-   strength and originality of the use case
-   technical feasibility
-   quality of previous work
-   understanding of AUDD and its potential applications
-   overall quality of the proposal

### **Grant amount**

Funding ranges from **AUDD 1,000 to AUDD 10,000**, depending on the scope and potential impact of the project.

### **Why this matters**

We think Australian dollar stablecoin infrastructure will unlock a new layer of digital finance. SolAUDD is a chance to build early, shape real use cases, and help define how AUDD moves on-chain.

If that sounds like your kind of build, apply.

metadata.description:
# About The Grant

Superteam USA now supports Solana Foundation Grants. These are grants for projects working on promoting decentralization and censorship resistance on the Solana network.

Even though the primary focus of the grants is to fund dApps and technical contribution, the Foundation may also support content and community grants that fit within the stated goals of the Grant program. Anyone with an idea or proof of work is welcome to apply and receive funding decision for a $1 - $10,000 grant. The Solana Foundation hands out these grants typically once a month.

## 🎯 Areas of focus:

1.  Promote Decentralization. Create developer tooling, media, content, and community projects focussed on promoting and bringing more decentralization to Solana as well as the world at large.
2.  Make Solana more censorship resistant. Primarily technical projects and code contributions which can help us make Solana the most censorship resistance platform for building dApps on.
3.  DAO Tooling: Create coordination, communication, and payments tools for communities using Solana as the backbone of their infrastructure.
4.  Education: Create media, programs, events, initiatives, etc., to onboard users, earners, and builders to crypto and Solana.
5.  Developer Tooling: Create tools, programs and hacks making it easier and faster for engineers to built the next generation of dApps on Solana.
6.  Payments: Build payments apps for consumers and businesses, making P2P payments, as well as commerce better integrated with the crypto ecosystem using Solana Pay.
7.  Cause-driven building: We’re also looking to fund projects and research around using crypto to create a more inclusive financial system, and innovative solutions towards climate change.

You can read more about the Solana Foundation Grants Program [here](https://solana.foundation/grants).  
  

💡 The Solana Foundation receives tens of applications every week, and may not have the time to give detailed feedback on every application. Please keep that in mind before you apply.

## ⚙️ How It Works:

1.  Submit the application form on Superteam Earn.
2.  The Foundation does their best to respond within ~7 days.
3.  If approved, you'll receive an email notification for onboarding and further steps.
4.  Update the community once a week on your progress.
5.  As you achieve your self-described milestones, receive the rest of your funding.
6.  Submit finished work for feedback, review, and distribution.

## 🤝 Guidelines

1.  Be Concise: Being clear and concise is always helpful.
2.  Build what the ecosystem needs: Besides our [Grant Proposals](https://solana.org/grants#RequestforProposals), we often see people on Twitter (and elsewhere) saying things like "Solana needs X" or "Solana would be better if it had Y". Use this information!
3.  Open Source: Being clear and concise is always helpful. What makes decentralized applications so powerful is that it’s built on the premise of being open and composable. Therefore, this grant support teams that intend to open source soon after deploying on Solana’s Mainnet Beta.

## ❓**Frequently asked questions**

-   Who is eligible to apply for an Instagrant?
    -   Anyone in the US!

-   How fast is "Instant"?
    -   We try our best to get you a decision within 7 days.

-   What criteria will the panelists use to evaluate grants?
    -   We prefer projects that 1) yield results quickly and 2) are executable by the Proposing team.

-   What conditions apply?
    -   The only condition is that you keep the community updated on a regular basis as your project progresses.

-   What is the philosophy behind the Instagrants program?
    -   **Proof of Work > Credentials.** Anyone is welcome to apply for Instagrants, given they have enough Proof of Work to make the review committee believe the work will get done.
    -   **Speed > Perfection**. We want to give grants rapidly. Not perfectly. We trust people to get work done.
    -   **Believers > Consensus.** As long as a minimum quorum of the reviewing committee believes it's a good use of funds, we will fund it

-   Will I receive feedback on my proposal if it is rejected?
    -   Unfortunately, our sponsors do not have the ability to provide individualized feedback at this time.

**Note**: The Superteam USA team does not manage the Foundation’s grant program. We simply make recommendations to the sponsors of the grant program on quality grant applications. You are also free to apply directly on their website for a grant.

🚁 _Have a question that isn't answered here? Drop an email to nicky@solanaeco.io for help._

metadata.description:
# Audiences Post, Communities Host

TL;DR: All our feeds are cooked and touching grass with friends is the final defense. The Superteam touching grass fund is here to support members who host, not just post. Get up to $500 USDG to cover expenses for organizing Solana & Superteam adjacent meet-ups in your city, as per the guidelines below.

Social media platforms are no longer social. By default, you don't see content from your friends, family, or people you're connected with. Instead, our feeds are dominated by sophisticated professionals who are engineering content to elicit a dopamine response while competing for max share of our attention that they can then package and sell to sponsors. In such times, IRL events are the last defense to compete with brainrot.

_Audiences post, communities host_: A big focus for each Superteam is to be the frontier onboarding vehicle for the most promising talent in their local markets. However, the magic happens when members go from sharing memes in a group chat to forming teams on Solana, and often forge lifelong friendships in the process.

The optimal way to participate in Superteam is to use the access & trust from being a member to find your niche interest and the people you can collaborate with to create weekend projects, products, or companies around it. Those who do it right will find themselves in more group chats than they can count, spontaneously joining Zoom calls and taking cabs/trains/planes to meet their internet friends. More on this idea in a previous blog post [here](https://blog.superteam.fun/p/audiences-post-communities-host?utm_source=publication-search).

Therefore, Superteam now supports the Solana Foundation community grants program and recommends applicants with the ability to galvanize the community with in-person events for community grants.

Members are encouraged to host casual events like coffee mixers, dinners, paddle or pickleball tournaments, turf football or cricket, or more structured events like learning groups, weekend hackathons, bounty hunting, or co-working sessions.

As long as you're doing something that (a) brings the Solana community closer together and (b) onboards those on the sidelines into crypto, feel free to apply. Currently, only Superteam members can be hosts, but anyone can attend. If this format works, we will drop the host restriction and open it up to anyone in the Superteam ecosystem.

## **🤝 Events Playbook**

The meetups are supposed to be a lot of fun, but it's not all there is to a valuable meetup. To have a higher chance of success—and to get more from the touching grass fund down the line—we recommend doing as many of these as possible:

-   **Limited attendees:** Invite a small group of not more than 8–10 people. Focus on a size and venue that enables everyone to talk to everyone else at least once. A generic meetup isn't the best fit for this; we're only looking to support meetups where attendees are: developers, operators (marketing, product, ops), creators (writers, researchers, YouTubers, etc.), investors (both angels and VCs), founders, and capital markets professionals.
-   **Primer on crypto:** Depending on how much is necessary, help folks find their way into the Superteam and Solana ecosystem. Make them feel at home!
-   **Merch (optional):** Coordinate with your local Superteam team to get merch—T-shirts, stickers, bags, etc.—for attendees to take back as a souvenir.
-   **Food & Coffee:** If this is part of your event, an ideal meal is one where (1) everyone can talk to each other, and (2) it's reasonably priced and prudently ordered without wasting food or money.
-   **Onboarding:** If you're inviting people who are new to crypto or Solana, ideally you should also act as their buddy & help them find their pathway to contribution via bounties, gigs, jobs, hackathons, asset onboarding/distribution, etc.
-   **Proof of meet-up:** Ideally, take pictures and put them up on your social media of choice with a short caption sharing your experience, learnings, or thoughts. Tag your local Superteam as they might share it as well!
-   **Follow-up group:** Invite everyone who attends into a private Telegram/WhatsApp group that you're an admin of. This way you can stay in touch and help make more plans that were discussed at dinner!

### **What this grant is** **_not_** **for:**

Events that are purely social or personal with no direct link to Solana or Superteam goals. Misuse of funds or falsified reports can potentially result in being purged from the Superteam membership.

## **⚙️ How It Works**

1.  Create a private event page on Luma. Please ensure you've added an appropriate title, cover image, and a full description of the event — including the format of the event, schedule if any, who the event is for, outcomes for the event, etc.
2.  Make a grant application for it here on Earn, and include the private Luma link of your event in the application.
3.  Sponsors will usually reply within ~7 days.
4.  If approved, you'll receive a confirmation email. Once approved:
    1.  Submit your event to the [Superteam Calendar](https://luma.com/superteam) so it's visible to the broader community.
    2.  You'll receive 50% of the grant upfront (post KYC; to be done on this page on Earn) in the following weekly payout cycle. Approved KYC and payments are sent for processing on Mondays and paid to you by Friday of the same week.
